feeds.title: Winter Garden, FL
feeds.description: Winter Garden, FL is dedicated to keeping residents informed and up-to-date by providing the latest news about sports, business, performing arts, health/safety issues, human interest and more.

feeds.title: Orange Observer
feeds.description: Orange Observer News is the digital publication for the West Orange Times & Observer and the Windermere Observer. The Observer are hyperlocal community newspapers that specialize in reporting neighborhood news and events in West Orange County and Winter Garden city.
